text:
sophie_support: FYI customer (AcmeSearch) is hitting 500s when calling /v1/rerank with embeddings payload. They see intermittent latency spikes (2.5-4s) then a hard failure. Reported request id: req_1932104559. Also saw a brief 401 earlier when their client rotated tokens. Need repro steps + bundle so we can hand to runtime.
kira_support: thanks. can you paste the raw request body they used and the exact curl they ran? also any server request ids or edge ids would help.
sophie_support: pasted sanitized curl below (they scrubbed PII). note: their embeddings array mixes two vector sizes — some vectors are length 1536, others 1024. customer says model=rdrw-embed-large in the call.
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model":"rdrw-embed-large",
    "query_embeddings": [[0.1,0.2,... 1536 values ...],[0.2,0.3,... 1024 values ...]],
    "candidate_embeddings": [[...1536...],[...1536...]],
    "top_k": 10
  }'
```
sophie_support: their client library batcher merges historical embeddings (from an old model) with current ones. they said it used to work until last week.
dan_engineer: tagging eng-runtime. quick check: if model expects 1536 and sees 1024 we should return 400 not 500. can you grab the runtime log for req_1932104559 and the edge id? there might be a handler that throws on reshape.
logbot: uploaded logs for req_1932104559 to internal logstore: /logs/1932/req_1932104559.log (sanitized). snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:22:19.431Z ERROR runtime.validation dimension_mismatch expected=1536 got=1024 request=req_1932104559
stack: runtime/reshape.go:87 runtime/handler.go:142
returning status 500 to client
```
miguel_ml: this looks like a model-version mismatch in the customer's pipeline. two paths:
- reproduce locally with a small batch that mixes 1536 & 1024 vectors
- confirm their client rolled forward a legacy model embedding pipeline recently

kira_support: can we get the customer to run a minimal repro curl that we control? ask them to send exactly three embeddings all 1536 and confirm it succeeds, then a mixed batch to reproduce the failure. provide curl snippet they can run.
sophie_support: shared a guided repro to customer:
```bash
# 1) homogeneous (expected to succeed)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rdrw-embed-large","query_embeddings":[[0.01,...1536],[0.02,...1536],[0.03,...1536]],"candidate_embeddings":[[...1536...]],"top_k":5}'

# 2) mixed (expected to fail)
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rdrw-embed-large","query_embeddings":[[...1536...],[...1024...]],"candidate_embeddings":[[...1536...]],"top_k":5}'
```
sophie_support: customer ran both. homogeneous returned 200 in ~170ms. mixed returned 500 in ~3.2s (matches their report). they uploaded a small debug bundle with curl + request headers to our secure intake: s3://redwood-debug/acme/req_1932104559_bundle.tar.gz
dan_engineer: grabbing bundle. quick triage notes:
- handler raised a runtime panic when trying to allocate reshape buffer
- fallback path returns 500 instead of a typed 4xx
- batching layer doesn't validate vector dims when merging historical cached embeddings

miguel_ml: probable root cause: cache entries stored with older model dims weren't validated at merge time. fix should be a dimensionality guard at cache-join phase and a clear 4xx to caller.

kira_support: next actions for support handoff:
1) create internal incident SUP-8291 and link bundle
2) ask customer for last 5 request ids around the timeframe in case of retries
3) provide workaround: ensure client batches by model version or run a conversion step

sophie_support: created SUP-8291 and assigned to eng-runtime. added link to s3 bundle and the log path.

oncall_bot: deploy note: service runtime v2.14.1 was deployed 2026-03-15T13:50:02Z. investigate if this release changed merge behavior.

dan_engineer: i'll repro locally with a mixed-batch script and send a small patch to add a validation early return + better error code. will update ticket when I have a PR. pinging @miguel_ml for review of schema assumptions.

miguel_ml: will review. also recommend communicating to customer the transient 401 they saw was a separate token rotation window; unrelated to dimension failures.

kira_support: i'll send customer an interim note: "we can reproduce; engineering is working on a fix. in the meantime, please avoid mixing embeddings generated by different model versions in a single batch." :thumbsup:

sophie_support: customer acknowledged, provided 3 follow-up request ids: req_1932104561, req_1932104574, req_1932104590. uploading into SUP-8291.

kira_support: thanks all. will keep thread updated with eng progress and ETA.
